Element.Name: Develop report objects
Element.copyright:
© 2012, 2022 EYGM Limited. All Rights Reserved.
Privacy Notice

Powered by Global Methods in conjunction with Consulting Methods
Element.attribute:
If a package is being used, develop the package application reports according to design specifications, and as prioritized by the software development plan. Inform functional design team of any design issues due to technical limitations.

If customized reports are to be developed, ensure that the appropriate development standards are being followed.

As the reports are developed, keep the following in mind:

  • Basic error handling, messages and audit trail
  • Calculation field overflows and errors (e.g. dividing by zero)
  • Field formatting (layout accuracy, decodes, pagination, headers, footers, tabs, currency, decimals)
  • Selection criteria all work (WHERE clause completeness)
  • Calculation correctness (summation and grouping)
  • Time/date/user stamps complete
  • Printing and downloading if specified
  • Sufficiently commented code
